description: Full-text search of commitfest entries (title, then people), the current commitfest unless commitfests; "phrase", -term, or. Each: cf_id, title, status, commitfest(s), people, last update, patch url, thread link, outlook (P(commit) or null). Operators: intitle:, from:, after:/before:, /regex/, commitfest:, release:. A commit SHA returns its threads' entries.

sort.description: Default relevance; likely/unlikely sort by P(commit)

name: search_commitfest
